chunks: Who is more unjust than he who, on being reminded of his Lord's revelations, turns away from them, and forgets the evil deeds he had committed in the past. Verily We have placed a covering on their hearts so that they do not understand, and a deafness in their ears so that however you may call them to guidance they will never be guided aright.
ai.seo_question: Why do some people remain unmoved by divine reminders and fail to accept guidance?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse elucidates the causal link between human agency ('what their hands have sent forth') and divine retribution, where persistent neglect of signs leads to a spiritual hardening of the heart. It underscores the concept of 'sealing' not as arbitrary divine decree, but as a consequence of prior choice, a theme central to the balance between free will and predestination in Shia theology. The mention of 'deafness' and 'veils' illustrates how intellectual arrogance creates a barrier to understanding the Quran's deeper meanings.
